description: One attachment of a message, whole: by 1-based index or filename substring (as get_message/get_thread list them). Text as text whatever its type (a .patch is ready for git apply); binary as base64 (encoding=base64). size = decoded bytes; url downloads it. Large text: read it in pieces with start_line/end_line (2000 lines a call; total_lines and cut say what is left). Cite https://postgr.es/m/<message_id>.

end_line.description: Text only: last line, inclusive, at most start_line + 1999

start_line.description: Text only: first line (1-based). Omit both for the whole attachment

name: get_attachment
